name: ts-nested-test-samples-fixture
description: Fixture: a monorepo package whose test suite nests many small sample-case directories under packages/core/tests (GitHub issue #50's Svelte-shaped layout), plus a shipped `packages/test` helper package imported by production code (a test-named directory that isn't a test suite), for JS/TS analyzer development. Its test suite also holds a runnable harness (`run-harness.js`) and a test helper (`helpers.js`) imported by `compile.test.js` and `render.test.js` (GitHub issue #65).
